bio: Scott David Wiener (born May 11, 1970) is an American politician who has served as a member of the California State Senate from the 11th district since 2016. A member of the Democratic Party, his district encompasses San Francisco and parts of San Mateo County. From 2011 to 2016 he served as a member of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors from the 8th district.
offices: Member of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors (2011–2016)
Member of the State Senate of California (2016–present)

items.t: Authored SB 519 (2021), decriminalizing possession of psilocybin, LSD, MDMA and other psychedelics; it passed the Senate but died in the Assembly.

items.t: Reintroduced psychedelic decriminalization as SB 58, which passed the Senate in 2023; Gov. Newsom vetoed it October 7, 2023.
items.q: SB-519 reemerged as SB-58 for the 2023-24 session, and on September 7 passed the Senate with 21 ayes and 14 noes.
